lines.speaker: Elior
lines.text: The water keeps showing the same hand — closing, closing, closing.

lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: At the feast. At the Lamp. At the Tree.

lines.speaker: Elior
lines.text: I have always believed that if I stop holding, everything I love will slip away — and God will look away with it.

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: That is the lie wearing your own voice.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: The pool does not accuse. It waits until you are ready to speak the wound plainly.
